heard: Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel Who supplied provisions for the king and his household Each one was responsible for one month of the year In the hill country of Ephraim Ben Hur stood Ben Dacre in Maccas and Shaubin Ben Hasten, Oreboth and the land of Hefan Ben Abinadab in all of Naphthdor Born a son of Ahila in Tanakh and Megiddo
